summary: One blocking finding is valid and will be repaired by making R1-R3 testable so spec-local test headers can cover them.

items.title: Test headers cannot cover requirements marked non-testable
items.rationale: R1-R3 are static prompt/source text requirements that spec-local tests can verify by reading the SDD flow skill source. Marking them non-testable conflicts with the acceptance criterion requiring R1-R4 header coverage.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements[0..2].testable are false while acceptance_criteria[3] requires spec-local tests to verify R1 through R4 with `// spec: R<N>` headers.
